title: The minimax optimal convergence rate of posterior density in the weighted orthogonal polynomials
summary: We investigate Bayesian nonparametric density estimation via orthogonal polynomial expansions in weighted Sobolev spaces. A core challenge is establishing minimax optimal posterior convergence rates, especially for densities on unbounded domains without a strictly positive lower bound. For densities bounded away from zero, we give sufficient conditions under which the framework of \cite{shen2001} applies directly.
